name: dsh-plugin-buddy
description: DSH 插件搭子：不用逛插件市场，也不用想关键词。说出你的任务，它从 1 万+ 社区插件里推荐可复用的优质插件，判断质量并给出上手步骤——让经过验证的方案直接为你所用，把精力留给真正的新问题。 · Plugin Buddy for DeepSeek Harness: describe a task and it recommends, judges, and onboards the right community plugin from 10,000+ entries — no manual market browsing, no keyword guessing; proven solutions put to work for you.
author: PilotHowe
